about: Whole hook scripts released vault-guard versions wrote, byte for byte, as rendered by install-hook from the published packages. Each script is its lines joined with LF; every script ends with a newline. sha256 is over those exact bytes. The repository's hygiene check allows no em dash in a tracked file, so the one em dash the 1.4.0 to 1.8.1 native scripts hold (U+2014) is written as the token {EM_DASH}, which the test replaces before hashing.

# Capture the status rather than branching on `if vault-guard ...`: after a
